reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is too vague, merely restating the general concept of entropic vs. enthalpic competition without specifying which atomic-scale segregation or ordering mechanisms are active, making it scientifically hollow.
reasons.testability: The proposed test lacks a specific temperature or composition where entropic stabilization is 'predicted to dominate', so the falsification criterion is circular and cannot be applied.
reasons.usefulness: It offers no actionable insight beyond the well-known high-entropy alloy paradigm and fails to guide a researcher on which specific factors to investigate.
